verdict.rationale: Headless or CI automation is a fair question for a payment service, so the axis applies, but the pack shows no headless, CLI, or CI-capable channel. The only software channel is a downloadable Batch Provider Software for tax professionals, and nothing says it runs unattended or in CI. Sign-in requires interactive MFA through Login.gov or ID.me, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or machine-readable interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
